limits: Training outcomes and predictors centered within site x depth to remove between-group level differences; held outcomes used ONLY for pair-difference scoring. Prediction is a relative ranking/contrast conditional on full held-group predictor survey, not absolute stock estimate.

Four meadows, groups of three grids, dependent pair differences; no p values, independent validation, or causal interpretation. Vegetative density x height is a structural proxy, not measured retention. Posthoc exclusion and mass-only are sensitivities.
Feature and model comparisons exploratory, fixed lambda 1 main descriptive comparison; .1 and 10 reported.
